line:

practice: Open the curtain before you decide what the day is. Let the house see you do it.

z: 獬 isinye, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Children are the usual casualties of a score kept between adults. They did not agree to carry it. Mercy toward the person you resent is also protection of the child.

practice: Do one undeserved kindness where you are keeping score. Do not mention the score.

z: 獮 isinye, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Siblings fight because they share a roof and a hunger. The fight is not the failure. The failure is when the stronger one discovers a liking for the smaller one's fear. Protection refuses that discovery.

practice: When the heat rises, name who you are actually keeping safe. Put your body between the danger and the child. Do not spend the heat on the child.

z: 獯 isinye, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Brothers and sisters are the first public. What you do to be admired at home becomes the way they will treat their own children. Give them a dignity they can copy.

practice: Once, take the lower seat on purpose. Let someone in the house finish a story you could have told better.

z: 獰 isinye, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
The teachings that endured all warn the eye. They also bless the eye that rejoices. Rejoicing is not a mood. It is a decision made again each time the other person shines.

practice: Clap, or thank, before you comment. Let the first sound from you be glad.

z: 獱 isinye, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Fear of the future makes a house small. Courage does not enlarge the future. It keeps today's people inside the house while the future remains unknown.

This is the work of a house after a loss. Here the body speaks by isinye, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele. 獱 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Tell the truth you have been saving, and remain in the room after it is told.

z: 獲 isinye, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Psychology is simple here. The closed hand teaches the body that the world is about to run out. The open hand teaches it that tomorrow includes other people.

This is the work of a house after a loss. Here the body speaks by isinye, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla. 獲 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Put one thing you were keeping back into the middle of the table.

z: 獵 isinye, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Gossip is how a house talks about its own when they have left the room. Healing speech waits until they are back, and then says the hard thing to the face, cleanly.

This is the work of a house after a loss. Here the body speaks by isinye, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 獵 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: If you gave someone a cruel name, retire it today, out loud, and do not use it again.

z: 獷 isinye, maphakathi eduze, kakhulu
line:
Across the old writings, the warning against scoffing is constant. A scoffer cannot be taught, and a house that scoffs cannot learn itself.

This is the work of a house after a loss. Here the body speaks by isinye, maphakathi eduze, kakhulu. 獷 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Look at one ordinary object they mended or prepared, and say what it cost them.

z: 獸 indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Some truths are not ready for speech. Presence holds them without using them as a weapon. A weaponized silence is still a weapon.

This is the work of a house after a loss. Here the body speaks by indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 獸 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: If your quiet has been a punishment, break it with one gentle sentence and then stay.

z: 獺 indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
A child who watches a break become a lifelong trial learns that love is a court. A child who watches a break become a mended bowl learns that love can survive its own failure.

This is the work of a house after a loss. Here the body speaks by indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele. 獺 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: If you were the one who broke trust, say what you did without a speech about why it was almost fair.

z: 獻 indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Compassion is grief that has recognized itself in another body and does not hurry it. Hurry is fear. The unhurried hour is the gift.

This is the work of a house after a loss. Here the body speaks by indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla. 獻 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Answer the ordinary request of a grieving child. Do not make them perform a sadness you recognize.

z: 獼 indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
The sciences of a lasting household call this resilience. The older word is faithfulness. It does not deny the dark. It refuses to let the dark be the only speaker.

This is the work of a house after a loss. Here the body speaks by indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 獼 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Decline the word forever. Keep the true sentence about the pain, and stop before the lie.

z: 玁 indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Many sacred traditions, in different grammars, say the same hard thing: the injury stops when someone declines to pass it on. This is not weakness. It is the end of a chain.

This is the work of a house after a loss. Here the body speaks by indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 玁 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Tell the truth of the wrong once, to the person, and then do not serve it at breakfast.

z: 玄 indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
At the table, anger wants the last word. The last word is rarely food. Let the sentence end before it becomes the story the children will tell about this house.

This is the work of a house after a loss. Here the body speaks by indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele. 玄 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: If you have already burned someone you love, say so before the day ends, and then do one ordinary kindness with your hands.

z: 玅 indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
The guest at the table is a test you did not schedule. If your worth requires the guest to be less clever, less beautiful, less faithful, your worth is a costume. Take it off.

This is the work of a house after a loss. Here the body speaks by indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, phezulu, ngakwesokudla. 玅 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Kneel, or sit, so your eyes meet a child's. Stay there until the conversation is theirs.

z: 率 indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
What you wish were yours, name it exactly, in the hearing of the person who has it. Then do not reach. The naming is the confession. The not-reaching is the turn.

This is the work of a house after a loss. Here the body speaks by indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 率 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Ask the person to show you how they did the thing. Be a student for ten minutes.

z: 玉 indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Name the loss you are counting. Often it is a person in the room, not a disaster outside. Then put your body beside that person. That is the whole practice.

This is the work of a house after a loss. Here the body speaks by indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 玉 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Hold the doorway. Let the frightened one see that you are not leaving.

z: 玊 indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Give before you calculate whether you will be thanked. Thanks are not the food. If you require them, you have made a trade, and a trade is not yet a family.

This is the work of a house after a loss. Here the body speaks by indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele. 玊 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Give a thing away that you still like. Do not wait until you are tired of it.

z: 玔 indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Wisdom is not silence forever. There is a time to speak. The test is whether the words can be repeated in front of the person, and still be a kindness.

This is the work of a house after a loss. Here the body speaks by indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla. 玔 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Tell one story tonight in which a person in this house is repaired, not mocked.

z: 玕 indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Look at the work you have stopped seeing. Name it. The naming is not flattery. It is the return of sight, and sight is the turn.

This is the work of a house after a loss. Here the body speaks by indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 玕 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Ask to be shown a skill you had decided was beneath you. Watch the whole way through.

z: 玖 indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Put the glowing thing in another room. Sit where you can be seen. You do not have to be interesting. You do have to be in the house.

This is the work of a house after a loss. Here the body speaks by indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 玖 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Be findable. Tell the house which room you will be in, and be in it.

z: 玘 indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Accountability is the first half. Without it, forgiveness is a fog. The one who broke the trust says what was done, without a speech about why it was almost justified.

This is the work of a house after a loss. Here the body speaks by indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele. 玘 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Decide, and say, whether the person is still a member. Do not leave them in a fog.

z: 玜 indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
The oldest writings are full of lament, not because lament is holy by itself, but because love that cannot lament becomes hard. Let the house be soft enough to cry.

This is the work of a house after a loss. Here the body speaks by indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla. 玜 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Leave the empty place unspoken-of only if the grieving person wishes it. Otherwise, speak the name.

z: 玞 indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Despair often tells the truth about pain and then adds a lie about forever. Keep the truth. Decline the forever. Forever is not a fact available to a person at a window.

This is the work of a house after a loss. Here the body speaks by indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 玞 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Set one place at the table that despair said was pointless. Eat there.

z: 玟 indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Accountability remains. Mercy is not the cancellation of truth. It is the decision that truth will not be used as a knife at breakfast for the next twenty years.

This is the work of a house after a loss. Here the body speaks by indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 玟 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Do one undeserved kindness where you are keeping score. Do not mention the score.

z: 玠 indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
An elder who has turned anger into protection does not become mild. The wall is still warm. What changes is the face it turns toward. It faces the street, not the cradle.

This is the work of a house after a loss. Here the body speaks by indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele. 玠 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: When the heat rises, name who you are actually keeping safe. Put your body between the danger and the child. Do not spend the heat on the child.

z: 玢 indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
An elder's dignity is not the right to be obeyed in every small thing. It is the right to be respected while still listening. The listening is what makes the respect true.

This is the work of a house after a loss. Here the body speaks by indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla. 玢 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Once, take the lower seat on purpose. Let someone in the house finish a story you could have told better.

z: 玥 indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Across generations, envy of the young is fear of being finished. Admiration of the young is how an elder stays in the story without owning it.

This is the work of a house after a loss. Here the body speaks by indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 玥 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Say out loud, in the hearing of the person, the exact good you wished were yours. Then leave it theirs.

z: 玦 indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
An elder who has been afraid and stayed is a better teacher than an elder who claims never to have shaken. The shaking, survived, is the lesson.

This is the work of a house after a loss. Here the body speaks by indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 玦 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Stay until the scared person is breathing slowly. Do not explain the dark away before you have sat in it.

z: 玨 indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
An elder who gives the best piece away is not being careless with the future. The elder is showing the future how a house continues.

This is the work of a house after a loss. Here the body speaks by indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele. 玨 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Pass the best portion first. The first piece teaches the house what it is.

z: 玩 indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla
line:
An elder's stories are a kind of speech that builds or bends a family. Tell the story in which people are repaired. The other story will tell itself.

This is the work of a house after a loss. Here the body speaks by indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla. 玩 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Speak the true sentence. Keep the second one, the one that only wanted to win.

z: 玫 indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
An elder who still notices the small faithfulness in the house is a gift to the young. The young become what is noticed.

This is the work of a house after a loss. Here the body speaks by indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 玫 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Look at one ordinary object they mended or prepared, and say what it cost them.

z: 玲 indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
An elder's quiet can be a shelter or a locked door. The young can tell which, by whether they are welcome to come and say nothing beside you.

This is the work of a house after a loss. Here the body speaks by indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 玲 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: If your quiet has been a punishment, break it with one gentle sentence and then stay.

z: 玳 indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Some breaks end a household. That too can be told with dignity. Forgiveness then is the refusal to poison the years that follow. The children still have to live in them.

This is the work of a house after a loss. Here the body speaks by indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele. 玳 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: If you were the one who broke trust, say what you did without a speech about why it was almost fair.

z: 玵 indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla
line:
An elder who speaks of the dead by name, without recruiting the young into despair, gives the family its memory and its future in the same breath.

This is the work of a house after a loss. Here the body speaks by indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla. 玵 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Bring food. Take the lower seat. Stay past the moment you become uncomfortable.

z: 玷 indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
An elder who has looked again, many mornings, is a quiet argument against the lie. Do not turn the elder into a slogan. Let the morning itself be seen.

This is the work of a house after a loss. Here the body speaks by indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 玷 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Make one plan for tomorrow small enough that both of you can keep it.

z: 玹 indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
An elder who lays down a feud gives the young a future that is not already written. That is one of the last great gifts a generation can give the next.

This is the work of a house after a loss. Here the body speaks by indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 玹 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Leave one cut unanswered today. Do not announce the leaving.

z: 玻 indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Anger is the house defending itself before it has measured the threat. Left alone, it burns the people it meant to keep. The heat is not the enemy. Direction is. Turned, the same heat stands in the doorway so the small ones can sleep.

This is the work of a house after a loss. The member drawn is indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 玻 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Before the second loud sentence, step into the doorway, not toward the person. Let the heat guard the house from outside.

z: 玼 indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Pride needs an audience and a person beneath it. Dignity needs neither. Hidden inside pride is the refusal to be nothing. That refusal is good. It becomes poison only when someone else must be smaller for it to stand.

This is the work of a house after a loss. The member drawn is indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 玼 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Kneel, or sit, so your eyes meet a child's. Stay there until the conversation is theirs.

z: 玽 indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Envy is love of a good thing, twisted until the good thing must shrink. The love was real. That is why it hurts. Turned, the same look becomes admiration, which is fed by another person's light.

This is the work of a house after a loss. The member drawn is indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 玽 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Ask the person to show you how they did the thing. Be a student for ten minutes.

z: 玿 indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, maphakathi eduze, kakhulu
line:
Fear is the mind counting what it loves and what it could lose. That count is not a defect. It is proof of attachment, and attachment is how a family exists. Courage is fear that stays in the room.

This is the work of a house after a loss. The member drawn is indlala yezinso, izindlala, izinso, maphakathi eduze, kakhulu. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 玿 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Hold the doorway. Let the frightened one see that you are not leaving.

z: 珀 indlala yobuchopho, indlala, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Greed is the fear that there will not be enough, wearing the mask of appetite. Bread kept in a closed hand goes stale. Generosity is the same hand remembering the table.

This is the work of a house after a loss. The member drawn is indlala yobuchopho, indlala, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 珀 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Feed the guest, or the youngest, before you take your own share.

z: 珂 indlala yobuchopho, indlala, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
The tongue is the smallest member and the widest fire. Every tradition that lasted put a guard on it, because a family is made of sentences more than of walls.

This is the work of a house after a loss. The member drawn is indlala yobuchopho, indlala, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 珂 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Say the hard thing to the face, once, cleanly, with no audience.

z: 珅 indlala yobuchopho, indlala, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Contempt is a shortcut. It saves a person from having to look. Inside it is the power it refuses: the power to see a thing clearly. Clear sight is the beginning of thanks.

This is the work of a house after a loss. The member drawn is indlala yobuchopho, indlala, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 珅 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Remove the sneer from a sentence and speak it again. Notice how much of it was only the sneer.

z: 珈 indlala yobuchopho, indlala, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:

line:

This is the work of a house after a loss. The member drawn is indlala yomphimbo, indlala, izindlala ezincane zomphimbo, izindlala, umgudu womoya, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. practice: When the heat rises, name who you are actually keeping safe. Put your body between the danger and the child. Do not spend the heat on the child.

line:
Self-reflection is the moment you notice you needed to win. Accountability is saying so before you are forced. The turn from pride to dignity is mostly this small honesty.

practice: Once, take the lower seat on purpose. Let someone in the house finish a story you could have told better.

line:
Siblings are assigned the same story and different gifts. Envy calls this injustice. Admiration calls it a house with more than one lamp. Both lamps belong on the table.

practice: Clap, or thank, before you comment. Let the first sound from you be glad.

line:
Many houses, under many names, give the same command: do not be ruled by dread, and do not despise the person who is. The strong are asked to stay, not to sneer.

practice: Tell the truth you have been saving, and remain in the room after it is told.

line:
Hospitality is the oldest sociology of the lasting house. The stranger eats first. The family that cannot do this for a guest will eventually fail to do it for itself.

practice: Put one thing you were keeping back into the middle of the table.

line:
Siblings remember the name they were called on the worst day. Do not give them that name. Give them the name of the good you have actually seen them do.

Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 琯 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: If you gave someone a cruel name, retire it today, out loud, and do not use it again.

line:
Children who are met with contempt learn to hide the clumsy part, which is most of them. Appreciation gives that part a chair.

This is the work of a house after a loss. The member drawn is indlala yomphimbo, indlala, izindlala ezincane zomphimbo, izindlala, umgudu womoya, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 琰 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Look at one ordinary object they mended or prepared, and say what it cost them.

line:
The old practice of sitting with the sick, of keeping watch, of not filling the air, is this turn. Do not rush to be useful. Be there.

practice: If your quiet has been a punishment, break it with one gentle sentence and then stay.

line:
The wisdom shared by many houses is hard: do not let the sun go down on a break you are willing to heal, and do not call it healing if you are only waiting to retell it.

This is the work of a house after a loss. The member drawn is indlala yomphimbo, indlala, izindlala ezincane zomphimbo, izindlala, umgudu womoya, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 琲 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: If you were the one who broke trust, say what you did without a speech about why it was almost fair.

line:
Children grieve in strange hours and then ask for ordinary things. Both are grief. Answer the ordinary thing. Do not make them perform a sadness you can recognize.

practice: Answer the ordinary request of a grieving child. Do not make them perform a sadness you recognize.

line:
A child who sees an adult look again, after a bad day, learns that a bad day is not a verdict. This is worth more than any optimism you could announce.

practice: Decline the word forever. Keep the true sentence about the pain, and stop before the lie.

line:
Children are the usual casualties of a score kept between adults. They did not agree to carry it. Mercy toward the person you resent is also protection of the child.

This is the work of a house after a loss. The member drawn is indlala yomphimbo, indlala, izindlala ezincane zomphimbo, izindlala, umgudu womoya, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 琵 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Tell the truth of the wrong once, to the person, and then do not serve it at breakfast.

line:
Siblings fight because they share a roof and a hunger. The fight is not the failure. The failure is when the stronger one discovers a liking for the smaller one's fear. Protection refuses that discovery.

This is the work of a house after a loss. The member drawn is indlala yomphimbo, indlala, izindlala ezincane zomphimbo, izindlala, umgudu womoya, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 琶 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: If you have already burned someone you love, say so before the day ends, and then do one ordinary kindness with your hands.

z: 琹 indlala yomphimbo, indlala, izindlala ezincane zomphimbo, izindlala, umgudu womoya, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Brothers and sisters are the first public. What you do to be admired at home becomes the way they will treat their own children. Give them a dignity they can copy.

Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 琹 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Kneel, or sit, so your eyes meet a child's. Stay there until the conversation is theirs.

line:
The teachings that endured all warn the eye. They also bless the eye that rejoices. Rejoicing is not a mood. It is a decision made again each time the other person shines.

practice: Ask the person to show you how they did the thing. Be a student for ten minutes.

z: 琿 indlala yomphimbo, indlala, izindlala ezincane zomphimbo, izindlala, umgudu womoya, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Fear of the future makes a house small. Courage does not enlarge the future. It keeps today's people inside the house while the future remains unknown.

This is the work of a house after a loss. The member drawn is indlala yomphimbo, indlala, izindlala ezincane zomphimbo, izindlala, umgudu womoya, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 琿 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Hold the doorway. Let the frightened one see that you are not leaving.

line:
Psychology is simple here. The closed hand teaches the body that the world is about to run out. The open hand teaches it that tomorrow includes other people.

practice: Give a thing away that you still like. Do not wait until you are tired of it.
